description: Canonical dependency policy for the CYNIC workspace. All crates must use workspace dependencies to prevent version conflicts and supply chain attacks.

workspace_canonical.description: Any dependency shared by 2+ crates must be declared in [workspace.dependencies] and consumed via .workspace = true
workspace_canonical.rationale: Prevents version conflicts and ensures single source of truth

lockfile_committed.description: Cargo.lock must be committed and up-to-date
lockfile_committed.rationale: Ensures reproducible builds and prevents supply chain drift

no_unvetted_git_deps.description: No git dependencies unless explicitly approved in registry.json
no_unvetted_git_deps.rationale: Git dependencies bypass crates.io audit and are supply chain risks

audit_required.description: cargo audit must pass before merge

registry_allowlist.description: Only registries listed in .cargo/config.toml are permitted
registry_allowlist.rationale: Prevents dependency confusion attacks via rogue registries

no_duplicate_packages.description: No duplicate packages in cargo tree (same crate, different versions)
no_duplicate_packages.rationale: Duplicates increase attack surface and binary size

workspace_dependencies.description: Canonical versions for all shared dependencies

conflicts.description: Active version conflicts that must be resolved
